from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialResult(BaseModel):
    """One company's quarterly financial results from a 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'quarter ended March 31, 2025')")
    
    net_income: str | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income/loss amount as string (negative if loss)")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of net income (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    
    operating_cash_flow: str | None = Field(description="Net cash from operating activities as string")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of operating cash flow")
    
    investing_cash_flow: str | None = Field(description="Net cash from investing activities as string")
    investing_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of investing cash flow")
    
    financing_cash_flow: str | None = Field(description="Net cash from financing activities as string")
    financing_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of financing cash flow")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_results: list[FinancialResult]
